## Security and privacy checklist

- [ ] I did not include real client/audit documents, confidential filenames, databases, logs, screenshots, or exports.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, tokens, certificates, signing keys, private endpoints, internal hostnames/IPs, VPN details, or private network-share paths.
- [ ] I used synthetic test data only.
- [ ] I documented any new dependency, network access, filesystem permission, Tauri capability, or security-boundary change.
- [ ] I did not weaken CSP, approved-root validation, source-path checks, evidence integrity, or audit logging without explaining why.
- [ ] Relevant tests/build checks pass.
